scope: Refuse VIEW typed DXF output when render mode group 281 is outside Autodesk's published domain, without changing DWG parsing or encoding.

implementation.behavior: DRW_View::validateDxf now requires renderMode <= 6. DWG parsing/encoding continues to use validatePayloadFields and retains its existing wire-width behavior.
implementation.failureBehavior: ASCII and Binary VIEW writes reject renderMode=7 before record emission and preserve an existing destination prefix. The documented upper bound 6 is serialized and read back exactly.

focused.coverage: Both ASCII and Binary: renderMode=7 refusal preserves an existing destination; renderMode=6 serializes and reads back exactly. Existing VIEW reference mapping, refusal and fresh-writer retry controls in the same selector pass.

limits: No physical VIEW producer or native rendering evidence was used.
The guard establishes published enum-domain output correctness only; it does not qualify VIEW rendering, graph closure, or whole-document DWG-to-DXF conversion.
No DWG parser/encoder behavior changed and no support claim was promoted.
next: Continue source-backed implementation and whole-document graph work; keep native VIEW rendering and physical producer qualification open.
